description: One knob (start or end) moved to a boundary, a slot from the other, pushing it if needed. A knob that ends up where it was keeps its own date; only a moved knob takes its slot's date.

cases.name: the start knob moves to a slot's date
the end knob moves to a slot's date
dragged onto the other knob, it pushes it a slot along
the end knob pushes the start knob back
a knob that doesn't move keeps its own date, in a gap
the other knob off-screen keeps its date
past the edge, a knob stops on it
